Aragonese

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]

Cognate with Spanish camino.

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): /kaˈmino/
  • Syllabification: ca‧mi‧no
  • Rhymes: -ino

Noun

[edit]

camino m

  1. way; path; road

Derived terms

[edit]
  • de camino

Further reading

[edit]
  • “camino”, in Aragonario, diccionario aragonés–castellano (in Spanish)

Catalan

[edit]

Verb

[edit]

camino

  1. first-person singular present indicative of caminar

Chavacano

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]

Inherited from Spanish camino.

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): /kaˈmino/, [kaˈmi.no]
  • Hyphenation: ca‧mi‧no

Noun

[edit]

camino

  1. way, path
  2. road
    Synonym: calle

Italian

[edit]

Alternative forms

[edit]
  • cammino (Tuscan)

Etymology

[edit]

From Latin camīnus, from Ancient Greek κάμῑνος (kámīnos).

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): /kaˈmi.no/
  • Rhymes: -ino
  • Hyphenation: ca‧mì‧no

Noun

[edit]

camino m (plural camini)

  1. fireplace
    Synonym: caminetto
  2. chimney
    Synonym: ciminiera

Derived terms

[edit]
  • tiracamino

References

[edit]
  • camino1 in Treccani.it – Vocabolario Treccani on line, Istituto dell'Enciclopedia Italiana

Anagrams

[edit]
  • Monica, camion, cimano, macino, macinò, manico, monaci, monica, nomica

camino m

Spanish

[edit]
Spanish Wikipedia has an article on:
camino
Wikipedia es

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): /kaˈmino/ [kaˈmi.no]
  • Audio (Mexico):(file)
  • Rhymes: -ino
  • Syllabification: ca‧mi‧no

Etymology 1

[edit]

Inherited from Old Spanish camino, from Vulgar Latin or Late Latin cammīnus, from Gaulish; compare Portuguese caminho, Italian cammino or French chemin.

Noun

[edit]

camino m (plural caminos)

  1. way, route
    Synonyms: vía, ruta
  2. road
    Synonym: calle
  3. path
    Synonym: sendero
